newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-BEVAN HITS UNBEATEN CENTURY IN OPENING TOUR MATCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BEVAN HITS UNBEATEN CENTURY IN OPENING TOUR MATCH.

text.p: Left-hander Michael Bevan struck an unbeaten 100 on Sunday in an Australian total of 358 for eight declared on the second day of the opening tour match against the Indian Board President's XI.

Bevan, dropped on 39, hit eight boundaries and clouted off-spinner Aashish Kapoor and left-arm spinner Sunil Joshi for a six apiece to sprint to his century from 156 balls in 175 minutes. At the close the President's XI were 85 for two..
Paceman Doddanarasiah Ganesh made early inroads when the Australians resumed at 122 for one after Saturday's rain-interrupted opening day.

Ganesh claimed the scalps of Michael Slater (56) and Mark Waugh (10) and Australia were in further trouble when medium-pacer David Johnson dismissed Ricky Ponting (58) and off-spinner Kapoor had Steve Waugh caught behind for 27.

Bevan and wicketkeeper Ian Healy restored respectability to the Australian innings with a 107-run partnership for the sixth wicket before Healy fell one run short of a well-deserved half-century when he nicked Joshi to give wicketkeeper Saba Karim his fifth victim of the innings.
Healy's 49 runs came from 72 balls in 78 minutes and contained six fours.
Ganesh was the most successful bowler for the President's XI with five for 103.
Paceman Paul Reiffel struck back for the Australians, dismissing openers Vikram Rathore (15) and Sanjay Manjrekar (20) to finish with figures of two for 13 from seven overs at the close.
